messages:
olivia: Quick thread — ran an end-to-end "pagerized KV" experiment across regions/GPU combos. TL;DR: H100 wins p99 for long seqs but A100 with paging-heuristics + lighter kernel gives better overall tokens/sec for mixed SLEN. Details below.

raj: nice. what runs did you include?

olivia: H100(us-west1) baseline (fused-attn-v2 + no-paging), H100 + pager (custom pager kernel v2), A100(eu-west1) + pager+evict-smart, A100(ap-southeast1) low-memory config w/ 4-bit quantized model. Run ids: run_8421..run_8424. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/kvpager/run_842[1-4]/

deploy-bot: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/kvpager/run_8421/summary.json :white_check_mark:

kevin: can you paste the short numbers? p50/p95/p99 and hitrate by seqlen buckets?

olivia: paste: 
```
seqlen bucket: 16 | hitrate 98% | p50 8ms | p95 12ms | p99 18ms | toks/sec (H100 pager)=22k | A100 pager=20k
seqlen bucket: 64 | hitrate 92% | p50 10ms | p95 18ms | p99 30ms | toks/sec H100=18k | A100=17k
seqlen bucket: 256 | hitrate 68% | p50 24ms | p95 60ms | p99 140ms | toks/sec H100=9k | A100=11.5k
seqlen bucket: 1024 | hitrate 22% | p50 60ms | p95 160ms | p99 440ms | toks/sec H100=3.2k | A100=4.8k
```

olivia: notes: H100 fused-attn kernel gives lower per-token latency when KV cache hits are high (short seqlens). But when paging kicks in, H100's paging kernel v2 has higher p99 due to page-copy overhead. A100 + smart-evict (prefetch window tuned to 64 tokens) reduced cross-region paging stalls and improved long-seq throughput.

ana: interesting — how much does quantization affect hit compression / page size?

olivia: 4-bit RTQ reduced KV footprint ~2.4x vs fp16, which bumped hitrate ~+6% for mixed workload, but increased decode CPU overhead slightly. On A100 low-memory config that was the difference between 45% and 51% effective hitrate for 256 bucket.

kevin: kernel choices? fused vs cutlass vs triton?

olivia: tested three kernel stacks:
- fused-attn-v2 (H100 optimized, low-latency for short seqs)
- cutlass-gemm+manual-kv (better sustained throughput for large kvs on A100)
- pager-kernel-v2 (our custom async page mover with NVMe overlap)
Pager-kernel-v2 shows best throughput for >256 seq when paired with cutlass on A100.

raj: any config knobs you'd recommend for prod rollout?

olivia: yes: 
- prefetch window 64 for mixed PLG workloads
- eviction policy: recency-weighted LFU with 2x aging for long sessions
- enable 4-bit RTQ on constrained nodes
- route long-seq to A100 region when possible (cost/throughput tradeoff)

kevin: LGTM. can you add a tiny runbook for ops to monitor regression signals?

olivia: added quick checklist in artifacts (s3 link). Also pasted a tiny alert rule:
```
alert: kv_pager_p99_spike
expr: increase(kv_pager_p99[5m]) > 2x AND kv_hit_rate < 0.6
severity: page
runbook: https://redwood.internal/runs/kv-pager/runbook
```

ana: thanks. can we schedule a short sync to decide region routing policy?

raj: +1, propose Wed 10am PT

olivia: booked Wed 10am PT. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
